core_findings.summary: The scene declares metres at scale 1.0, while research-camera Z values are approximately 132-295 scene units. A world-unit-to-metre contract is not encoded clearly enough for metric trajectory evaluation.
Found 29 CAM_* research cameras plus 1 imported/navigation camera candidate(s).
1 camera(s) have a non-finite lens value. They cannot be used for calibrated projection without an approved correction.
The scene has 30 AREA_* and 28 PORTAL_* objects. They are semantic volumes/boxes without an encoded walkable-surface or topology contract.
Stair AREA boxes exist, but no stair entry/exit portals, direction, floor connection, or parameterized path metadata is encoded.
At least one 1F/2F portal pair has an identical transform and dimensions; the floor label or placement may be incorrect.
No object name explicitly identifies a NavMesh or walkable surface. AREA_* and stair candidates exist, but their geometry semantics require confirmation.
8 mesh objects meet the 50,000-polygon review threshold. This is a complexity signal, not a deletion decision.
18 OUTER3X3 area lights exist. They are not needed by the geometry-only Phase 1 algorithms but may be needed for synthetic rendering.
The file contains 260 materials and 447 images; Phase 1 geometry processing should avoid loading appearance data where possible.

duplicate_looking.interpretation: Shared datablocks usually indicate intentional instances. Coarse signatures use counts, dimensions, and materials only; neither category authorizes deletion.

semantic_area_box_inventory.interpretation: AREA_* and PORTAL_* boxes are semantic candidates only; they do not prove walkable surfaces, navigation edges, or stair transitions.
